arxiv-2005-11768.creator: Jiajing Wan*, Xinting Huang*
arxiv-2005-11768.description: Abstract 0 0 footnotetext: *denotes equal contribution. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. License details: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . This paper presents our strategies in SemEval 2020 Task 4: Commonsense Validation and Explanation. We propose a novel way to search for evidence and choose the different large-scale pre-trained models as the backbone for three subtasks.

arxiv-2105-03128.title: Pairing and nonaxial-shape correlations in N = 150 N=150 isotones
arxiv-2105-03128.creator: Kenichi Yoshida
arxiv-2105-03128.description: Abstract Background Rotational bands have been measured around 250 Fm associated with strong deformed-shell closures. The K π = 2 − K^{\pi}=2^{-} excited band emerges systematically in N = 150 N=150 isotones raging from plutonium to nobelium with even- Z Z numbers, and a sharp drop in energies was observed in californium.

arxiv-2112-11633.title: Classification of pivotal tensor categories with fusion rules related to S ​ O ​ ( 4 ) SO(4)
arxiv-2112-11633.creator: Daniel Copeland, Cain Edie-Michell
arxiv-2112-11633.description: Abstract In this paper we classify all semisimple tensor categories with the same fusion rules as Rep ⁡ ( S ​ O ​ ( 4 ) ) \operatorname{Rep}(SO(4)) , or one of the associated truncations. We show that such categories are explicitly classified by two non-zero complex numbers.

arxiv-2206-01940.title: Neutrino spin oscillations in
arxiv-2206-01940.creator: gravitational fields in higher dimensions
arxiv-2206-01940.description: Abstract Neutrino physics is one of the most active fields of research with important implications for particle physics, cosmology and astrophysics. On the other hand, motivated by some theories including string theory, formulation of physical theories in more than four space-time dimensions has been the subject of increasing attention in recent years.

arxiv-2302-00388.title: Short-term Prediction and Filtering of Solar Power Using State-Space Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2302-00388.creator: Sean Nassimiha, Peter Dudfield, Jack Kelly, Marc Peter Deisenroth, So Takao
arxiv-2302-00388.description: Abstract Short-term forecasting of solar photovoltaic energy (PV) production is important for powerplant management. Ideally these forecasts are equipped with error bars, so that downstream decisions can account for uncertainty. To produce predictions with error bars in this setting, we consider Gaussian processes (GPs) for modelling and predicting solar photovoltaic energy production in the UK.

arxiv-2310-10915.title: Identifiability of the Multinomial Processing Tree-IRT model for the Philadelphia Naming Test Technical Report
arxiv-2310-10915.creator: Andrew Womack, Daniel Taylor Rodriguez, Gerasimos Fergadiotis, William D. Hula
arxiv-2310-10915.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Naming tests represent an essential tool in gauging the severity of aphasia and monitoring the trajectory of recovery for individuals afflicted with this debilitating condition. In these assessments, patients are presented with images corresponding to common nouns, and their responses are evaluated for accuracy.

arxiv-2508-05794.title: Entropy and polynomial entropy of derived autoequivalences of derived discrete algebras
arxiv-2508-05794.creator: Tomasz Ciborski
arxiv-2508-05794.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to calculate entropy in the sense of Dimitrov–Haiden–Katzarkov–Kontsevich and polynomial entropy as defined by Fan–Fu–Ouchi of derived autoequivalences of derived discrete algebras over an algebraically closed field. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 18E30; Secondary: 16G10 1.

arxiv-2509-09197.title: Improving Synthetic Data Training for Contextual Biasing Models with a Keyword-Aware Cost Function
arxiv-2509-09197.creator: Chin Yuen, Jia Qi, Eng Siong
arxiv-2509-09197.description: Abstract Rare word recognition can be improved by adapting ASR models to synthetic data that includes these words. Further improvements can be achieved through contextual biasing, which trains and adds a biasing module into the model architecture to prioritize rare words.

arxiv-2510-08633.title: The optical photometric variability of Herbig Ae/Be stars from TESS Facilities: TESS Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , astrocut ( Brasseur et al. 2019 ) , lightkurve ( Lightkurve Collaboration et al. 2018 )
arxiv-2510-08633.creator: Ann Marie Cody, Lynne A. Hillenbrand, Shreya Chandragiri, Marvin Morgan
arxiv-2510-08633.description: Abstract We have carried out a photometric time domain study of 188 intermediate-mass young stars observed in Full Frame Image mode with the TESS satellite over the first 3.3 years of its mission. The majority of these targets are classified as Herbig Ae/Be stars (HAeBes).

arxiv-2601-22184.title: Tacit Coordination of Large Language Models
arxiv-2601-22184.creator: Ido Aharon, Emanuele La Malfa, Michael Wooldridge, Sarit Kraus
arxiv-2601-22184.description: Abstract In tacit coordination games with multiple outcomes, purely rational solution concepts, such as Nash equilibria, provide no guidance for which equilibrium to choose. Shelling’s theory explains how, in these settings, humans coordinate by relying on focal points: solutions or outcomes that naturally arise because they stand out in some way as salient or prominent to all players.

pmc-10535650.title: HPV Vaccination in Immunosuppressed Patients with Established Skin Warts and Non-Melanoma Skin Cancer: A Single-Institutional Cohort Study
pmc-10535650.creator: Simon Bossart, Cloé Daneluzzi, Matthias B Moor, Cédric Hirzel, Kristine Heidemeyer, S Morteza Seyed Jafari, Robert E Hunger, Daniel Sidler, Eyad I Elkord
pmc-10535650.description: cSCC (cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma) and its precursors are a major cause of morbidity, especially in immunosuppressed patients, and are frequently associated with human papillomavirus (HPV) infections. The purpose of this study is to investigate the therapeutic potential of alpha-HPV vaccination for immunosuppressed patients with established cSCC and its precursors.

pmc-10606381.title: On the Optimal Error Exponent of Type-Based Distributed Hypothesis Testing †
pmc-10606381.creator: Xinyi Tong, Xiangxiang Xu, Shao-Lun Huang, T Aaron Gulliver, Songze Li
pmc-10606381.description: Distributed hypothesis testing (DHT) has emerged as a significant research area, but the information-theoretic optimality of coding strategies is often typically hard to address. This paper studies the DHT problems under the type-based setting, which is requested from the popular federated learning methods. Specifically, two communication models are considered: (i) DHT problem over noiseless channels, where each node observes i.i.d.

pmc-11334535.title: Multimodal imaging to distinguish microvascular and morphological changes in retinal vein occlusion after intravitreal ranibizumab with or without triamcinolone acetonide injection
pmc-11334535.creator: Nan Wang, Jingling Zou, Shengguo Li, Xianghui Deng, Jun Zeng, Chun Ding
pmc-11334535.description: BackgroundThe study was designed to investigate microvascular and morphological changes in retinal vein occlusion (RVO) using multimodal imaging after intravitreal ranibizumab (IVR) with or without triamcinolone acetonide (IVTA) injections.MethodsThis was a retrospective and observational study. Fifty patients (52 eyes) diagnosed with RVO were enrolled.

pmc-11488267.title: Postoperative decrease in serum albumin as predictor of early acute periprosthetic infection after total knee arthroplasty
pmc-11488267.creator: Yoshinori Ishii, Hideo Noguchi, Junko Sato, Ikuko Takahashi, Hana Ishii, Ryo Ishii, Kei Ishii, Kai Ishii, Shin-ichi Toyabe
pmc-11488267.description: PurposePatients with hypoalbuminemia, (serum albumin (SA) < 3.5 g/dL) are at greater risk for complications after surgery, including increased postoperative infection rates after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This study aimed to analyze both preoperative and postoperative SA in patients who experienced acute periprosthetic infection within the first 4 weeks after surgery.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed data from 490 consecutive TKAs (314 patients).

pmc-11503773.title: Transition-Metal-Related Quantum Emitters in Wurtzite AlN and GaN
pmc-11503773.creator: Kamil Czelej, M Rey Lambert, Mark E Turiansky, Aleksei Koshevarnikov, Sai Mu, Chris G Van de Walle
pmc-11503773.description: Transition-metal centers exhibit a paramagnetic ground state in wide-bandgap semiconductors and are promising for nanophotonics and quantum information processing. Specifically, there is a growing interest in discovering prominent paramagnetic spin defects that can be manipulated using optical methods. Here, we investigate the electronic structure and magneto-optical properties of Cr and Mn substitutional centers in wurtzite AlN and GaN.

pmc-11514755.title: Transcriptomic analysis of spleen-derived macrophages in response to lipopolysaccharide shows dependency on the MyD88-independent pathway in Chinese giant salamanders (Andrias davidianus)
pmc-11514755.creator: Jie Deng, Mengdi Han, Jingyu Gong, Hongying Ma, Yinting Hao, Cheng Fang, Han Zhang, Jia Li, Wei Jiang
pmc-11514755.description: BackgroundGram-negative bacteria are the main bacterial pathogens infecting Chinese giant salamanders (Andrias davidianus; CGS) in captivity and the wild, causing substantial economic losses in the CGS industry. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying pathogenesis following infection remain unclear.ResultsSpleen-derived macrophages from healthy CGS were isolated, cultured, and identified using density gradient centrifugation and immunofluorescence.

pmc-12595571.title: A Bibliometric and Visual Analysis of Cancer Screening Based on the Web of Science Core Collection Database
pmc-12595571.creator: Wanrong Dai, Baixu Wu, Jie Sun, Wuping Shuai, Shuying Han
pmc-12595571.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: This study aimed to systematically analyze the current research status, development trends, collaborative networks, and hot topics in the global cancer screening field using a bibliometric method. It sought to reveal the contributions and influences of different countries and institutions and explore potential directions for future research, providing a comprehensive basis for academia and policy-makers to optimize cancer screening strategies.Methods: We searched the Web of Science Core Collection on October 15, 2023, using TS = (cancer screening) and DT = (Article),

pmc-12646905.title: Efficacy of multimodal rehabilitation strategies on gastrointestinal function recovery in postoperative aortic dissection patients: a narrative review
pmc-12646905.creator: Jing-Hua Xiao, Jing-Xue Wei, Zi-Ting Bi, Lang Huang, Yuan-Hong Dai, Yun-Shan Zhang
pmc-12646905.description: Aortic dissection is associated with significant postoperative gastrointestinal dysfunction, a common complication that adversely affects patient prognosis. Recent advancements in multimodal rehabilitation strategies have shown promise in enhancing postoperative gastrointestinal recovery, but their impact on gastrointestinal function recovery in patients after aortic dissection surgery remains unclear.

pmc-12716011.title: Discovery of the Postcoital Contraceptive Effect of Rhus pentaphylla in a Study of Acute, Subchronic, and Neurodevelopmental Toxicity of Ethanolic Leaf Extract
pmc-12716011.creator: Fatimazahra Agouram, Aicha Ezoubeiri, Abderrahman Chait, Stefania Garzoli, Zahra Sokar
pmc-12716011.description: In the present study, the acute, subchronic, and neurodevelopmental toxicity of Rhus pentaphylla, a Moroccan medicinal plant, was investigated in Swiss albino mice. HPLC analysis showed the presence of phenolic compounds with rutin as the principal component. The ethanolic leaf extract showed low acute toxicity with a lethal dose 50 (LD50) of more than 5 g/kg.

pmc-13018431.title: Effect of positive feedback from patients on resident doctor's well-being
pmc-13018431.creator: Priyanku Saikia
pmc-13018431.description: The effect of patient's gratitude on the well-being of Residents Doctors, especially in helping to reduce burnout is of interest. Therefore, it is of interest to assess the effect of gratitude on emotional exhaustion, depersonalization and a sense of personal accomplishment among trainees using a mixed-methods approach.

pmc-13356201.title: Comparison of Psychometric Performance of Faculty and Student Authored Anatomy Exam Items in Medical Education
pmc-13356201.creator: Shanna Williams, Helen Kaiser, Sydny Long
pmc-13356201.description: Near-peer teaching is an effective method for improving student retention and comprehension in undergraduate medical education. This approach involves students providing content instruction to peers who are one or more years junior. Both the student-teacher and the recipient have been found to benefit from increased self-confidence and understanding of the material in pre-clinical and clinical environments.

pmc-13510209.title: Unraveling Effects and Pharmacological Mechanisms of Phellodendrine on Inflammatory Bowel Disease
pmc-13510209.creator: Yufeng Xie, Ziyi Zhou, Xuqianzi Wu, Jiayin Teng, Xiaorun Zhang, Yue Sun, Lixin Chen, Lijian Ding, Wei Yuan

pmc-13609181.title: Longitudinal Visual Evoked Potential Changes Show Distinct Associations with Relapse Activity and Disability in Relapsing–Remitting Multiple Sclerosis: A Multicenter Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13609181.creator: Samet Öncel, Meral Seferoğlu, Sami Ömerhoca, Semanur Aksu, Ertuğrul Çınar, Hakan Kılıçaslan, Abdulkadir Tunç, Nilüfer Kale İçen
pmc-13609181.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and Objectives: Visual evoked potentials (VEPs) are established tools for detecting optic pathway involvement in multiple sclerosis (MS); however, the distinct clinical significance of longitudinal changes in latency and amplitude remains unclear. This exploratory study aimed to evaluate the clinical utility of serial VEP assessments in patients with relapsing–remitting MS (RRMS) by examining the associations between temporal changes in latency and amplitude and concurrent markers of disease activity and disability.
